labels: Knees far over the toes, hips open

text.setup: Hold a support with one hand, feet hip-width. Rise onto the balls of your feet.
cues: Push your knees forward and lean back, keeping a straight line from knees to shoulders.
Lower until your knees are well past your toes and you feel the stretch in your quads.
Drive your knees back to stand tall.
mistakes: Bending at the hips so it becomes a normal squat.
Going deeper than your knees are ready for — build the range slowly.

variants.plate: Hold a plate against your chest with your free hand once bodyweight is easy.
variants.machine: A sissy squat stand locks your feet and pads the shins, so you can lean back further.
